newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 6.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Military modifies Sky Sword missile.
Dual leadership system proposed by Democratic Progressive Party revives.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Ruling Nationalist Party and opposition Democratic Progressive Party cooperate to revive three articles of proposed constitutional amendments.
Taiwan eases rules to allow planting of betelnuts on private lands.
LIBERTY TIMES - Government agencies to start five-day work week every other week from 1998.
Taiwan expands police forces to fight crime.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - U-Land Air Lines plans to invest in a Vietnamese airline.
Taiwan's January-May consumer price index hits nine-year low.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Banks cut interest rates.
Cement industry to be allowed to invest in mainland China.
